topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Oh no, I can't believe it, they called it off. I mean, I know things happen, but this was supposed to be a big deal, you know? We've been planning this for so long, just to make you feel special. I’m sure there’s a really good reason, something important, and I guess we’ll find out. But right now, it just feels like… I don’t know, everything’s just a bit off. I wish there was something I could do, something to fix it. I’m here, though, okay? Whatever you need, I’m right here.
